text:
maya: Heads up — seeing a handful of partner-acme logins fail JIT with a 400 role assignment error. Not everyone; maybe ~10% of attempts this morning.

sam: Any recent Okta mapping changes?

maya: We shipped a mapping tweak yesterday to require the `department` SAML claim for role mapping. Example from the mapping file: 
```
{
  "attributes": ["email", "department"],
  "enforce_required": true
}
```

kevin: Can you paste the auth logs for a failing request?

maya: Log snippet: 
```
[OKTA] 2026-03-18T10:12:05Z POST /saml/assertion 400 role_assign_error missing claim: department user=joe@acme.com
[OKTA] 2026-03-18T10:12:07Z POST /saml/assertion 200 user=amy@acme.com role=viewer
[OKTA] 2026-03-18T10:13:12Z POST /saml/assertion 400 role_assign_error missing claim: department user=bob.contractor@acme.com
```

lee: Partner IdP historically omits `department` for contractors/short-term consultants. Our SCIM sync only populates department for full_time users, so that fits.

sam: Does missing department currently -> deny (400) or fallback to a default role? It should fallback to `viewer` ideally.

kevin: The mapping change set `enforce_required=true` so missing required claims now surface as 400 instead of mapping defaults. That flag was enabled in the 2026-03-17 deploy (deploy-bot #2026-03-17T22:45).

oncall-security: Created SECURITY-INC-2242: JIT role mapping failing for external users (P2).

maya: Temporary mitigation: I'll flip enforce_required=false for the Okta mapping so we fall back to the default role while we investigate.

maya: Running change against staging -> then prod.

maya: Done — set enforce_required=false in /etc/okta/mappings/redwood-saml.json and reloaded mapping service. Can someone verify?

kevin: I triggered a login test for joe@acme.com — success, role=viewer. :thumbsup:

lee: Longer-term we should: 1) update SCIM rules to populate department for contractors where possible, 2) add a mapping case that maps blank department -> "contractor" role instead of error, 3) add a canary test for missing claims. I'll open infra tickets.

sam: Also add a dashboard alert when JIT role_assign_error rate > 1% over 1m so we catch regressions.

maya: I'll add a short postmortem draft and owners (kevin for mapping config, lee for SCIM sync, sam for alerts).

kevin: Note for follow-up: audit logs currently store the missing-claim events but do not include the Okta mapping version. Can we add mapping_version to audit entries so future rollbacks correlate?

maya: Good call — filing audit enhancement task.

okta-bot: Automated message: Okta app mapping changed by maya (enforce_required=false).

maya: Thanks everyone. Will update SECURITY-INC-2242 with timeline and next steps.
